govdocs-archive_org-sings-of-teh-great-n: Aleksandr Dugin's Signs of the Great North turns to the far north as a spiritual symbol. It takes up the cosmic law of rotation, the scholar Herman Wirth, and northern signs and myths. Dugin treats the pole as the still center of a turning world. The book belongs to his metaphysical writing rather than his party politics, and it shows how deeply myth shapes his thought.
